hooks.command: echo "# setup-agents:preflight — If this is a work instruction (implement, fix, review, generate, plan, research, document), do NOT start reading or editing files yet: first run the pre-flight, then create or claim a task and start its workflow (sf setup-agents workflow run). Registering the task is a precondition, not the work."; (sf setup-agents task list --json 2>/dev/null && sf setup-agents workflow pending --json 2>/dev/null) || true
